title: Best-Rated Rehabilitation Clinic in Sarasota | MD Fit
description: MD Fit is a 5.0-rated rehab clinic in Sarasota (89 Google reviews). What to look for in a rehab clinic, how our evaluation works and who we are right for.
lead: MD Fit is rated 5.0 from 89 Google reviews, and every plan is run start to finish by Dr. Jared Caban, MD, MSc, CEP, CCEP, LMT. Here is what to look for when you search for rehab near you, how our evaluation works and when we will say someone else is the better fit.

sections.h2: What to look for in a rehab clinic
sections.html:
Star ratings are a starting point, not an answer. Before you book anywhere in Sarasota, Bradenton or Venice, ask a few plain questions:

  • Who actually treats you? In many clinics the licensed clinician evaluates you and an aide runs the exercises. Ask how much time you will spend with the person who made the plan.
  • How long is the first visit? A 20-minute evaluation cannot look at your hips, spine and feet together. Problems that have lasted months need an hour or more to sort out.
  • Does the plan include hands-on work and exercise? Releasing a guarded muscle without changing the pattern that loaded it feels good for a day. Exercise without release means pushing through a muscle that is still protecting itself.
  • Will they tell you when they are not the right fit? A clinic that never refers out is not screening carefully.

sections.h2: How the MD Fit evaluation works
sections.html:
The evaluation is about 90 minutes and costs $300. Dr. Jared does all of it. It starts with your story: when the pain began, what makes it worse, what you have already tried, what you want to get back to. Then he looks at how you move. Outer-hip pain, for example, is often referred from the gluteus medius, and a low back that catches standing up often traces to the quadratus lumborum.

Hands-on testing follows: pressing on the muscles that refer to your pain to see whether they reproduce it, checking joint range and testing strength side to side. You leave with a plain-language explanation, the first release work done and two or three exercises assigned in the free MD Fit app.

sections.h2: What a first visit is like
sections.html:
Wear clothes you can move in. Bring imaging reports, surgical notes or medication lists if you have them; if not, the physical exam carries most of the weight. Expect to walk, squat, reach overhead and balance on one leg. Referred pain during firm soft-tissue work is normal and Dr. Jared will tell you what he is feeling for.

Follow-up visits are $150, usually a week or two apart at first, then further apart as the home program carries more of the load. Prefer to talk first? Free phone consult: 941-313-0562.

sections.h2: Who MD Fit is right for
sections.html:
• People who have been told their imaging is normal but still hurt.
  • Active adults in Sarasota, Siesta Key, Lakewood Ranch and Osprey who want to keep playing golf, pickleball or tennis, or keep running, while they rehab.
  • Post-surgical patients cleared for outpatient rehab who want one clinician following the surgeon's protocol closely.

Common reasons people come in include low back pain, shoulder pain, hip and knee pain, and pain that has lasted longer than six months.

sections.h2: How MD Fit differs from a standard PT clinic
sections.html:
Three differences matter most. First, one clinician: Dr. Jared performs the evaluation, the hands-on treatment and the strength coaching, so nothing is lost between the person who found the problem and the person coaching the fix. Second, the method combines medical massage and soft-tissue release with clinical exercise physiology, so the muscle is calmed and then loaded in the same plan. Third, the homework lives in a free app with a video library, a pain-pattern tool and structured programs.

MD Fit is a cash-based clinic and does not bill insurance, which is what lets a visit last as long as it needs to.

Being highly rated does not mean being right for everyone. Dr. Jared will refer you elsewhere, or back to your physician, when:

  • Your symptoms include the red flags below, or they progress despite a reasonable trial of care.
  • Numbness, weakness or reflex changes suggest a nerve problem that needs imaging or a specialist opinion.
  • Pain does not behave like a movement problem: constant, unrelated to position or activity, waking you at night and unchanged by hands-on testing.
  • You need a service we do not provide, such as injections, bracing or custom orthotics.

MD Fit is at 3214 Clark Road, Sarasota, FL 34231, Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 4 PM. Evaluation $300 (about 90 minutes). Follow-ups $150. Medical massage $250 for 60 minutes or $300 for 90 minutes. Free phone consult. No physician referral required.

timeline: Most people know within two or three visits whether the plan is working, because hands-on testing should reproduce and then change your familiar pain. Full recovery depends on the problem, how long you have had it and how consistently the home program gets done; Dr. Jared gives you a realistic range after the evaluation rather than a promise.
redFlags: Chest pain, shortness of breath, or pain spreading into the jaw or left arm: call 911.
New loss of bladder or bowel control, or numbness in the groin or inner thighs, needs emergency care the same day.
Progressive weakness in an arm or leg, or a foot that drags, should be seen by a physician promptly.
Unexplained weight loss, fever or night sweats alongside pain is a reason to see your doctor before starting rehab.
Pain after a fall that may involve a fracture needs imaging first.

faq.q: Why is MD Fit rated so highly?
faq.a: Reviewers most often mention the time Dr. Jared spends, that he explains what is happening and that one person does every part of the plan. The rating is 5.0 across 89 Google reviews.

faq.q: Can I come for a consult before paying for an evaluation?
faq.a: Yes. A free phone consult lets you describe the problem and ask whether MD Fit is the right fit before you book.

faq.q: Do I need a referral from my doctor?
faq.a: No. You can book directly. If you are post-surgical, bring your surgeon's instructions so the plan can follow them.
No. MD Fit is a cash-based clinic, which is what allows 90-minute evaluations with one clinician. Many patients use HSA or FSA funds.
